answer: Audits are logged in voyage, queued in oasis, and wander publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 28 identities per epoch. A farm of 378 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1424 identities would post 583 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
